description: 跨品牌电竞外设电量管理与硬件调度引擎, 支持雷蛇、罗技、雷柏、NuPhy 及主流国产电竞外设
notes: 安装和更新时会关闭程序内置的自动更新, 请用 scoop update ferris-pulse 升级。更新或卸载前请先退出程序。
post_install: if (Test-Path "$persist_dir\autostart-approved") { $approvedKey = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\StartupApproved\Run'; if (!(Test-Path $approvedKey)) { New-Item $approvedKey | Out-Null }; New-ItemProperty $approvedKey -Name 'FerrisPulse' -Value ([byte[]]@((Get-Content "$persist_dir\autostart-approved" -Raw) -split ',')) -PropertyType Binary -Force | Out-Null }
post_uninstall: if (Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'FerrisPulse' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Set-Content "$backup\autostart" '1' } else { Remove-Item "$backup\autostart" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if ($value = Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\StartupApproved\Run' -Name 'FerrisPulse' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Set-Content "$backup\autostart-approved" ($value.FerrisPulse -join ',') } else { Remove-Item "$backup\autostart-approved" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
